tut.hint.text: Here is what the AI is thinking right now.
tut.shuffle.title: Shuffling the deck
tut.shuffle.concise: New hand: the deck is being shuffled.
tut.shuffle.normal: The deck is shuffled with a fresh seed. In a seeded tutorial it is always the same shuffle, so you can watch every step twice.
tut.shuffle.detailed: The dealer cuts and shuffles the deck. In this tutorial the shuffle is driven by a fixed seed, which means the same cards will come out every time you replay it — perfect for studying a hand without worrying about the deck changing under you.
tut.deal.title: Blinds & hole cards
tut.deal.concise: Blinds posted. Two private cards land in front of you.
tut.deal.normal: Blinds are posted to open the betting round. Each player is then dealt two private hole cards — the only cards you can see about yourself.
tut.deal.detailed: The small blind (half a big blind) and the big blind (one big blind) act as the opening bet for the hand. After that the dealer hands every player two face-down hole cards. You play your hand using only your two cards plus the five community cards that will appear in front of the table.
tut.flop.title: The flop
tut.flop.concise: Three community cards hit the table.
tut.flop.normal: The flop: three community cards are revealed and a new betting round begins.
tut.flop.detailed: The first three community cards are dealt face-up. From here on every player can build their best five-card hand using any mix of their two hole cards and the community cards. A betting round starts from the first active player after the button.
tut.turn.title: The turn
tut.turn.concise: A fourth community card is revealed.
tut.turn.normal: The turn: a fourth community card is added to the board, then another betting round.
tut.turn.detailed: A fourth community card completes more of your potential hand. Watch the board texture — a straight or flush draw often appears right here. Another betting round follows from the same first active seat.
tut.river.title: The river
tut.river.normal: The river: the final community card is dealt, followed by the last betting round.
tut.river.detailed: The last community card is revealed. This is your final chance to commit chips before showdown. Most value and most bluffs land on this street, because the board is now complete and hand ranges narrow.
tut.bet.title: A bet is made
tut.bet.concise: A player puts chips into the pot.
tut.bet.normal: A player bets. Everyone after them must match the bet to keep playing this hand.
tut.bet.detailed: Betting is how pressure is applied. A bet sizes the pot relative to the strength of a player's hand. You can call (match), raise (put more in), or fold (give up the hand). The size of the bet tells you something about the range of hands the player is showing.
tut.fold.title: A player folds
tut.fold.concise: A player folds and leaves the hand.
tut.fold.normal: A player folds. They give up their hand and are out of this betting round.
tut.fold.detailed: Folding costs you nothing more on this hand — it is the cheapest way to avoid a hand you are likely behind on. If everyone except one player folds, that player wins the pot immediately with no showdown.
tut.showdown.title: Showdown
tut.showdown.concise: The best hand wins the pot.
tut.showdown.normal: Showdown: the remaining players reveal their hands and the best five-card hand takes the pot.
tut.showdown.detailed: If the betting ends with more than one player still in, each of them reveals their cards. The best five-card hand wins the pot. If two hands tie, the pot splits evenly (subject to table chip rounding rules).
